findings.source: MerkleProof.sol:122-127 bytes32 computedHash = leaf; for (uint256 i = 0; i < proof.length; i++) computedHash = Hashes.commutativeKeccak256(computedHash, proof[i]);
findings.issue: The loop variable holds computedHash - leaf instead of computedHash. The leaf hash sha3(sha3(...)) is added at each of its three uses in the body, subtracted in the update, and added back after the loop. Exact (text_check: all calls same), but it hides that the loop folds hashes starting from the leaf.
findings.rule: If a loop-carried variable v starts at 0 and every use, including its value after the loop, is v + e for a loop-invariant e, print w = v + e instead: w = e before the loop, w = <update> + e in the body (here s = leaf; s = sha3(mem[0 len 64])).
findings.verified: text_check run --per-selector 32 (r2 text): 451 + 128 calls, all same
